description: Search Amazon for Valentine's / romantic gift ideas on the user's marketplace. Returns PA-API products when configured for the default storefront, otherwise romantic-filtered search deep-link cards + catalogMatches. Prefer buyUrl / trackingTag in results. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale for the end user. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED — curated ASINs produce /dp links on amazon.se and amazon.com (US); other marketplaces get romantic search deep-links.

name: search_gifts
title: Search Valentine gifts
